Tamsin Reed, Grocer
Greeting: Morning! Bread's fresh, rope's sound, and the prices are fair. Mostly.

Name: Bertram Hale, Trader
Greeting: Step up, step up. Old Bertram buys what you bring and sells what you need.

Name: Elspeth Moss, Apothecary
Greeting: Mind the jars, dear. Some of them bite.

Name: Rook Varley, Potion Seller
Greeting: Potions! Fresh this morning. Well, this week.

Name: Ada Penny, Banker
Greeting: Welcome to the Oak Hill bank. Small, but nothing has ever gone missing. Nothing important.

Name: Cobb Penny, Bank Clerk
Greeting: Deposits on the left, withdrawals on the right. Or the other way round. I'm new.

Name: Dorran Ashby, Smith
Greeting: Hobb went off after better coin. The forge stayed. So did I.

Name: Grenna Oreheart, Ore Trader
Greeting: Ore, ingots, a good rock for the garden. Grenna has it all, small one.

Name: Edda Pike
Greeting: Lovely day for it, whatever it is.|The well's sweeter since the Steward had it cleaned.|My hens have stopped laying. I blame the weather.

Name: Old Tam Hollis
Greeting: Seventy winters in this town and I still get lost in the fog.|Mind the oak's roots. They've tripped better than you.|Back in my day the road ran the other way.

Name: Rosalind Fern
Greeting: I've a cough no potion can shift. I keep buying them anyway.|The garden's coming on, if the crows let it.|Have you met Rook? Don't believe a word he says.

Name: Jory Bell
Greeting: I'm off to watch the river. Someone has to.|The bridge is new. Well, newer than me.|Fish are biting downstream, they say.

Name: Mother Agnes
Greeting: Light a candle for the ones who went away and never wrote.|The bell needs a new rope. And a ringer with better knees.|Bless you, child.

Name: Fenn Cotter
Greeting: The Town Hall wants another form filled. Again.|I mend roofs. Yours looks fine. For now.|Agnes says I should come to church more. I come for the bread.

Name: Quillon Ashgrove, Broom Maker
Greeting: Every broom balanced by hand. Mind the bristles, they're still settling.

Name: Mirabel Thistle, Grocer
Greeting: Newt-free bread, honest scales and the odd talking turnip. Don't feed it.

Name: Barnaby Coinwhistle, Banker
Greeting: Your gold sleeps under three enchantments and one very grumpy lock.

Name: Mayor Oswin Fairweather
Greeting: Welcome to Silver Point! Please keep your spells pointed at the sky.

Name: Archmage Elowen Starling
Greeting: The Academy's doors are open to the curious. Mind the moving staircases.

Name: Torvald Emberhand, Smith
Greeting: Enchanted steel holds an edge forever. Ordinary steel just needs me more.

Name: Gilda Merriwick, Innkeeper
Greeting: Warm cider, cold pie and a fire that never goes out. Literally. We've tried.

Name: Hesper Nightshade, Apothecary
Greeting: Green bottles heal, red ones burn. Purple ones... we don't talk about purple.

Name: Alder Wyncroft, Wandwright
Greeting: The wand chooses the wizard. The staff, I'm told, chooses lunch.

Name: Madame Orla Vey, Seer
Greeting: Crystal balls, fine pipes and spellbooks. I knew you'd come in today.

Name: Pip Tumblewick, Pet Keeper
Greeting: Dogs, cats and owls, all well behaved. Mostly the owls.

Name: Old Fennick Moonbarrow
Greeting: The candles have floated over that square for three hundred years.|My beard was black once. Then I sneezed during a frost charm.|The Academy's tower leans a little more every winter.

Name: Tansy Larkspur
Greeting: I'm saving up for a willow wand. Alder says I'm not ready.|Have you seen my cat? Grey, sulky, answers to nothing.|The goblins took my sock again. Just the one.

Name: Ambrose Quill
Greeting: Madame Vey says I'll meet a tall stranger. You're about right.|A good pipe and a quiet evening, that's all I ask.|Spellbooks don't bite. Most of them.

Name: Wren Hollowmere
Greeting: Nightshade's potions are strong. Hold your nose and drink fast.|The herbs grow best by moonlight. So do the weeds.|Lovely evening for a broom ride.

Name: Cedric Brambleworth
Greeting: Gilda's cider would make a troll sing.|The Mayor's speeches run long. I bring a cushion.|Watch the sky at dusk. The candles light themselves.

Name: Isolde Fernbriar
Greeting: Mirabel's turnip told me a joke. I didn't laugh.|My grandmother flew to the coast and back before breakfast.|The north wind smells of snow already.

Name: Thaddeus Wicklow
Greeting: Torvald fixed my cauldron. It hums now. Is that normal?|Mind the cobbles, they shift about on their own.|I used to be a knight, you know. Then I read a book.

Name: Marigold Featherstone
Greeting: Pip's owls are the cleverest in the land. One does my sums.|I keep my savings at Barnaby's. And a little under the bed.|Have you met the goblins? Cheeky things, harmless though.

Name: Bartholomew Pennyroyal
Greeting: I'm on the town council. We mostly argue about candles.|Two hundred years old and still learning new hexes.|Good day, young one.

Name: Rosalind Ashby
Greeting: I teach charms at the Academy. Second years are the worst.|If you hear singing from the tower, don't go up.|Lovely to see a new face.
